name: The Unbound Launcher

app-icon.png.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production Android launcher app icon for The Unbound Launcher, an independent spatial Android launcher for AR glasses.
Primary request: Create a distinctive, polished app icon: a single bold open U-shaped ribbon that suggests an unbounded portal, with its right stroke lifting outward diagonally into open space. The U must remain instantly legible at 48 pixels. Confident compact silhouette, clean mathematically smooth edges, subtly dimensional but mostly flat, refined contemporary software identity. Use cool luminous blue transitioning to cyan, in keeping with a blue-accented Android interface, against a very dark midnight-blue background. Minimal and balanced, no visual clutter.
Composition/framing: exact square 1024 by 1024, full-bleed solid dark background to every edge, no baked rounded corners. Symbol centered and contained in the central 56 percent of the square for Android adaptive icon masking. Generous even negative space. The opening and lifted end communicate freedom and launching.
Text: no text, no letters besides the abstract U symbol, no wordmark.
Constraints: one finished icon only; no mockup, no device, no presentation sheet, no alternate icons, no border, no drop shadow outside the mark, no watermark. Avoid glasses silhouettes, rockets, generic infinity loops and any existing brand symbol.
app-icon.png.use: Master app icon; Android density assets are generated by tools/branding.py.

logo.png.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: transparent horizontal logo lockup for The Unbound Launcher.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved brand reference app icon. Reuse its exact blue-to-cyan open U ribbon symbol, silhouette, proportions, rising right tip and gradient.
Primary request: Create a polished horizontal logo, with the reference U mark on the left and a precisely typeset wordmark on the right. Keep the mark and lettering isolated on a genuinely transparent background. The symbol has NO square background or tile. Dark midnight-blue typography for use on light pages. Wordmark is refined, clean geometric sans-serif, beautifully spaced. Main line UNBOUND is bold and prominent. Smaller uppercase THE above, and widely spaced uppercase LAUNCHER below. The typography and symbol together form a coherent compact horizontal lockup.
Text (verbatim): "THE" "UNBOUND" "LAUNCHER". No other text.
Composition: wide horizontal canvas, ample transparent margin, optical alignment. Symbol height approximately matches the whole three-line wordmark. One final logo only.
Constraints: preserve the reference symbol identity exactly. No mockup, no device, no background, no shadow outside the symbol, no extra symbols, no watermark. Transparent alpha around and inside artwork.
logo.png.use: Transparent logo lockup with dark lettering for light backgrounds.

symbol.png.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent Android adaptive app-icon foreground for The Unbound Launcher.
Input image: Image 1 is the approved app icon edit target.
Primary request: Remove only the dark navy background from the supplied icon, isolating its exact blue and cyan U-shaped ribbon on genuine transparent alpha. Keep the U silhouette, its gradients, the lifted right tip, its proportions and visual appearance identical. Output a square canvas, symbol centered with transparent margins on all sides, no text, no tiles, no new elements. Interior of U must also be transparent. Smooth crisp clean edges. Preserve existing symbol; change only background to transparency.
symbol.png.use: Transparent standalone mark and Android adaptive foreground.

compatibility: Application ID, original XREAL legal attribution, source namespaces, preferences and historical build artifacts are retained.
